text: The lamp from the infirmary. The nurse kept a storm lantern by the end cot. With a light I can see the hall, and I know every sound in it. Bring it and I will tell you where they are.
Quiet now. Listen. The line is talking. They are coming along the belt, and from the brine tanks.
They are coming through the hall again. I will keep still. I am very good at keeping still.
Night shift, line two. When the doors were chained we were still on the line. I got under the clerk's desk. The others ran for the pens. ...Don't go down to the pens.
Seventy-one hours and five Scrip to show for it. My boy is up in the town with my mother. If the bell rings up there, they are alive. Listen for it.
Thank you. Keep your head down a moment. ...Hear that? The belt rattles when they cross it. There. And there.
Someone is down on the floor! Get them up, please, get them up!
